data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word "bahar" meaning 'moon' and the suffix "aa" which signifies 'light'. The name Bahraa symbolizes the light of the moon in the darkness of night, providing guidance and tranquility. The name Bahraa carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahraa usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Bahraa represents the light of guidance that can be found even in the darkest of times. It represents the presence of a divine force that can illuminate the path and provide comfort and peace of mind. The moon in Islamic tradition is also synonymous with the prophet Mohammad, known as the "Seal of the Prophets," as the last and most perfect embodiment of divine guidance. Thus, the name Bahraa can also be seen as a reminder of the presence and guidance of God.
